title: Remarks at the Aspinwall Hotel, Lenox, Massachusetts
paragraphs: There has been an accident. One of the members of the party has been killed; the driver, I fear, fatally injured. Under the circumstances I am sure you will understand my not stopping and not trying to make an address to you. I thank you heartily for the greeting that you extend to me. I shall ask you, the circumstances being as they are, not to cheer or make any demonstration. I thank you for coming here to greet me.
